competitors.name: Whole Foods Market
competitors.action: Whole Foods opened applications for its 2026 Local and Emerging Accelerator Program, a 12-week retail-readiness track for local and emerging brands not yet sold on Whole Foods shelves. Selected brands receive mentorship, education, potential financial support and consideration for placement in stores in their home city or region.

competitors.name: Canada TC Foods Inc.
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer's Summer Fancy Food Show coverage highlighted Canada TC Foods' frozen Chinese Burger, a street-food-inspired golden pastry filled with seasoned meat. The signal is that freezer innovation is continuing to borrow from global street-food formats that are familiar enough for mainstream trial but differentiated from standard frozen meals and pizza.

competitors.name: Large U.S. grocery retailers / Deloitte
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Deloitte survey findings from 100 senior U.S. grocery executives: 87% expect grocery marketing to become hyper-personalized, nearly half expect national CPG partnerships to become less important over time, and 66% expect reduced- or no-checkout experiences within five to 10 years.

trends.topic: Retail gatekeeping for emerging food brands is becoming more structured and data-driven
trends.magnitude: Whole Foods is again using LEAP to identify shelf-ready local brands, while Deloitte found 87% of large-grocer executives expect hyper-personalized marketing and nearly half expect national CPG partnerships to become less important.
trends.context: For Real Dough, buyer readiness increasingly means more than product quality: retailers are looking for brands that can support local-market traction, digital personalization, operational execution and clear differentiation against private label and national brands.
